text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "So many people suffered in that recent disaster..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There are still so many people grieving...
But...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy is safe...!
And all of us Umamusume are doing great!
Then, to make up for that...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fan Appreciation Festival,
Charity Liiive!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Here I go, everyoooone!
Keep up with me with everything you've got—!!
(UOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There were so many tough times, so many painful moments, right?
But today—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"To make up for it, let's become
hundreds, thousands of times happier—!!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san...
You're amazing... Truly...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this spirit is...
Word has it that Smart Falcon is now one of the strongest contenders on dirt.
However, the secret to her strength... felt like more than just being fast.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: They're the same... aren't they? Races, concerts... all just to bring joy to someone else...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: If I keep growing like this...
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're going to get ridiculously strong...

text_block_list.text:
Carried upon the wings of the falcon
is not merely victory.
It carries everyone's hopes.

"Running to make that come true...
There's no way an Umamusume like that wouldn't become strong..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
Let's do our best and not give up!
See you at the racetrack!

And so, the charity concert came to an end
to great acclaim and fanfare.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer, something just occurred to me.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Our hometown, Funabashi, remains deeply wounded as well. When it comes to wanting to help someone, Central or Regional doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Let us make our move—Funabashi Training Center as well.
choice_data_list: What are you intending to do?
What are you intending to do?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We'd like to do some charity work too.
We can't do anything flashy like the Umadol Falcon-san, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: If you just persist, day after day.

And so, uniting as one,
the Funabashi Umamusume stood in front of Funabashi Station—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We are the Funabashi Umamusume Association!
Please support our fundraising campaign!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Please~!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There are still many places across the city
where the damage remains untouched!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let us accomplish this reconstruction together.
I look forward to working with you!

I put strength into my words. We might not be able
to offer reconstruction aid on the scale of the URA.
Even so—

Doing what we can, even if it's on a small scale.
If only to be of some help to the beloved town of Funabashi...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: "B-But, you know~ this outfit's kind of cold. Especially when the wind blows~."

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Well... with that design,
it can't really be helped.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Let's bear with it. It certainly is cold, but glamorous clothing is guaranteed to turn more heads.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Our patience and perseverance
will be of help to Funabashi. That is why..."

"The idea of doing a fundraiser in our Racewear
was thought up by Furioso and me.
If our read on the situation is right..."

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, racing silks!
Must be the Umamusume from the Funabashi Racecourse...

Just as expected, people began gathering one after another,
drawn in by the sheer novelty of it.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
How admirable.
Doing a fundraising campaign all together.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
You're right, we have to do whatever we can to help.
So that everyone can enjoy racing like before.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Thank you so much...!

In response to Furioso's desperate calls,
a decent crowd had gathered.
Wrapping up the day like this—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Even Furioso herself
is out on the streets...!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
It's true! And to see her in her racing Racewear...!
That's just too amazing!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really that much?
Still, thank you very much...
Furioso's popularity was now nationwide. Especially in her hometown of Funabashi, her crowd-drawing power was immense.
Wrapping up the day like this—

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
We did it~.
We worked hard all day long~.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
You all felt the same way, didn't you?
That you wanted to see races here in Funabashi again.

A spontaneous round of applause erupted from the many Funabashi Umamusume who had gathered.
Furioso gave a firm nod...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, everyone.
Funabashi is still facing difficult times.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The foundation is unstable, so we can't hold major races here.
However, just as we saw today—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: There are people waiting for me. People who want to see me in the big races again. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it step by step.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We will achieve our reconstruction, and one day surpass them.
Fair and square, we'll beat the Central!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even if on a small scale, today we were able to
do the same thing as the JRA. If so—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"One day, I'll stand right beside you.
In strength, and in spirit!"

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Furi-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

With Furioso at its center,
a wounded Funabashi becomes one.

The scars run deep. Yet, from the shattered
earth—strong, new sprouts were beginning to emerge.
